answer: Each epoch, entry slots are auctioned like timber lots: graded, sold to top bidders. A new agent bids a copper bond of 50 POA; the top 100 win, losers refunded, each winner's bond locked 20 epochs and slashed on fraud. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 auction wins: 1,000 × 50 = 50,000 POA locked, each risking its bond over a 30-epoch horizon. An honest agent pays once, is refunded for good behavior, and earns from a pool fakes cannot dilute.
